AnnounceDays.description: How many days before it begins a happening is announced; 0 announces it at its own midnight.

Audience.description: Who hears that a happening began and ended: everybody, or those at its place.

CalendarEntry.description: A calendar entry as the file writes it: exactly one of `weekdays`, `date` and `monthday`.

date.description: Every year on this date, MM-DD, such as "10-31".

kind.description: The kind it schedules, by id.

monthday.description: Every month on this day, 1 to 28.

place.description: Where, by key: one of the kind's places.

weekdays.description: Every week on these weekdays, such as [saturday].

Days.description: How many days a happening runs: from day 1's `from` to day N's `until`.

EntityKey.description: An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

HappeningKindId.description: A kind's id: `market-day`, `festival`. The identifier rule of `contracts` (lowercase ASCII letters, digits, `-` and `_`, neither first nor last a separator), at most [`KIND_ID_MAX_BYTES`].

Hours.description: The local hours a happening runs on each of its days, in minutes since midnight: `from` before `until`, both on one day; `24:00` is a legal `until`. Written `HH:MM-HH:MM`.

Limits.description: The host's own caps (design §5.3), enforced on every draft from every source (INV-WE-6).

per_day.description: The most happenings that may begin on one day, world-wide: 1 to 16, 3 when unsaid.

per_place_running.description: The most happenings that may overlap at one place: 1 to 4, 1 when unsaid.

MonthSet.description: A non-empty set of months, written as their numbers: `[5, 6, 7, 8, 9]`.

PerDay.description: The most happenings that may begin on one day, world-wide.

PerMille.description: A chance per day, per mille: 0 never, 1 000 every day.

PerPlaceRunning.description: The most happenings that may overlap in time at one place.

RandomEntry.description: One `random:` entry: the kind, the place, its chance per day, and the weekdays and months it may fire in (all, if not given). `P` is how a place is named.

kind.description: The kind it draws, by id.

months.description: The months it may fire in, 1 to 12; every month when unsaid.

per_mille_per_day.description: Its chance per day, per mille: 0 never, 1000 every day.

place.description: Where, by key: one of the kind's places.

weekdays.description: The weekdays it may fire on; every weekday when unsaid.

RawKind.description: One kind as the file writes it: the catalog entry and its id.

announce_days.description: How many days before it begins it is announced, 0 to 30; 0 when unsaid.

audience.description: Who hears that it began and ended: public (everybody, the default) or place (those there).

days.description: How many days it runs, 1 to 14; 1 when unsaid.

hours.description: The local hours it runs on each of its days, HH:MM-HH:MM, such as "08:00-14:00".

id.description: The kind's id, such as market-day: 1 to 32 bytes of a-z, 0-9, - and _.

places.description: The 1 to 16 distinct places it may happen at, by key.

title.description: What the kind is called when shown, at most 64 bytes.

SystemId.description: The id of a System Pack, such as presence or calendar. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

Title.description: What a kind is called when it is shown: at most [`TITLE_MAX_BYTES`] of UTF-8 with no control character. Shown, never parsed.

WeekdaySet.description: A non-empty set of weekdays, written as their names: `[saturday, sunday]`.

calendar.description: Happenings on dates: each names exactly one of weekdays, date and monthday. At most 64.

generators.description: External generators this world selects, by system id, each once.

kinds.description: What may happen, where and at which hours: 1 to 64 kinds, ids unique.

limits.description: The world's caps on how many happenings begin a day and overlap at a place.

random.description: Happenings on a seeded chance per day; each (kind, place) once. At most 64.

seed.description: The seed every random draw comes from: part of the world, not the run's --seed.
